purpose: Tests the ten non-finalist patterns at wire segment lengths never covered by the original study (100, 125 and 206 mm). Establishes whether any non-finalist beats the revised J=160mm winner (4.4.4.4 at A~206mm), which the original screen over A<=160mm could not rule out.
id_note: Tiers 1 and 2 numbered from 900001, tier 3 from 930001, tier 4 from 960001. The unique key across the whole study is (tag, experiment_id); tag is recorded in every result file.
